name: ROCKWOOL
note: ROCKWOOL brand of listed ROCKWOOL A/S (Hedehusene, Denmark); Title Partner of the Denmark SailGP team (ROCKWOOL Racing SailGP Team) since 2019, renewed November 2025 through the end of 2032 (PR Newswire/SailGP release, checked 2026-10-03). Since February 2026 the team itself is owned and operated by American Magic (Doug DeVos), with ROCKWOOL continuing as Title Partner (americanmagic.com, 2026-02-12). Ownership chain tops out at ROCKWOOL A/S; its largest single shareholder is the non-commercial ROCKWOOL Foundation (23% of the share capital, 28% of the votes), with no state or state fund anywhere in the chain. Held unrated for a maintainer decision on METHOD's company record test: Rockwool Ltd (Pencoed, Wales) pleaded guilty at Bridgend Magistrates' Court in September 2008 to breaching health and safety law after worker Christopher Rowland John was pulled through a spinning chamber on 13 November 2006, suffering a compound arm fracture, five broken ribs and psychological damage that left him unable to return to work; fined £20,000 plus £7,500 costs (Wales Online, 2008-09-25) - a court guilty plea to an injury within 20 years, which plausibly meets the record test while the PR author read it as below the line. Also considered and not recorded: a 2022 'Stop Business with Russia' NGO report (via Business & Human Rights Resource Centre) on ROCKWOOL's Russian subsidiary supplying Russian Ministry of Defense tenders - not a court, regulator or UN finding.
